tests.notes: TypeScript completed successfully. The latest production Vite build passed after the document-clearance correction, transforming 8,481 modules in 3m40s, and the expanded focused mobile-dock Playwright regression passed. Direct production-browser measurement at 320x568 and 390x844 confirmed: the focused footer motion control ends 74.65625px and 74.265625px above the dock respectively; all six sampled points across the control, including its lower center, hit-test to the button; its 2px solid focus outline with 3px offset is visible; every dock target remains exactly 44x44 CSS px; and document scrollWidth equals clientWidth. At 768x1024 the shared mobile clearance resolves to 0px and the dock remains hidden. Earlier focused Vitest passed 4 files and 14 tests, and the full Playwright suite passed the reveal, SaaS positioning, reduced-motion, all-staff-route, complete Maria journey, and caregiver clinical-data exclusion scenarios.

notes_for_next_agent: The reveal primitive uses IntersectionObserver progressive enhancement, unobserves completed targets, promotes focused content immediately, and renders final content without observer support or under either reduced-motion source.
The SaaS section states the buyer, subscribed capability, configuration shape, and expansion path without pricing, fabricated integrations, or demo/prototype framing.
Clinical Glass tokens now cover public, gateway, patient, staff, caregiver, system, modal, navigation, and mobile-dock surfaces while preserving operational labels and workflow semantics.

Fixed body backgrounds, broad repeated blur, the staff nested vertical scroller, and eager live-map mounting were removed or bounded; the document owns workspace scrolling and the stable map fallback remains available.
Caregiver rendering remains transportation-only, and browser coverage confirms clinical symptom text is absent after the staff resolution flow.

The mobile Workspace dock now uses explicit 44x44 CSS-pixel interactive targets while retaining compact 16px icons, accessible labels, visible focus styling, safe-area spacing, mobile no-overflow behavior, and the existing desktop breakpoint behavior.

The shared mobile app shell reserves document-end clearance for the fixed dock footprint, viewport offset, focus ring, and safe area; the footer motion control is fully visible and hit-testable above the dock at both required mobile widths.
